whatIs.title: What Is a Muscle Recovery Massage?
whatIs.p1: A muscle recovery massage is a bodywork experience focused on areas that may experience muscle tension and physical overload, particularly after exercise, training, or periods of physical exertion.
whatIs.p2: Unlike a massage designed solely for relaxation, muscle recovery massage aims to combine wellness, relaxation, and physical recovery, adapting the intensity and techniques to what your body needs.
whatIs.quote: Because no two bodies are the same. Your session begins by listening to what your body needs.

reasons.title: Does Your Body Feel Tense or Overworked?
reasons.subtitle: Maybe it is time to pause. A muscle recovery massage can be an excellent option if you are looking to:
bullets: ✨ Relax muscles that feel tense or overworked
✨ Restore a sense of well-being after training
✨ Enjoy a moment of physical rest
✨ Release the feeling of built-up bodily tension
✨ Complement your exercise and wellness routine
reasons.conclusion: It is not simply about getting a massage. It is about feeling good in your own body again.

items.q: Is a Muscle Recovery Massage Only for Athletes?
items.a: No. Although it is widely enjoyed by physically active individuals, it can also be an option for anyone looking for muscle relaxation, physical rest, and overall wellness.

items.q: What Does a Session Feel Like?
items.a: The experience can vary depending on the individual and the intensity selected. Our goal is to provide a personalized experience while respecting your comfort, sensations, and individual needs.

items.q: How Long Does a Session Last?
items.a: The duration depends on the selected protocol. You can ask about the available options when booking your appointment.

items.q: How Often Can I Get a Muscle Recovery Massage?
items.a: The recommended frequency may vary depending on your physical activity, individual needs, and wellness goals. At MJ, we can guide you in finding a frequency that works for you.

items.q: Can I Have a Muscle Recovery Massage After Training?
items.a: Yes. It can be part of a wellness and post-workout recovery routine. The appropriate intensity and timing may vary depending on the type of physical activity you have performed.

items.q: Do I Need to Exercise to Enjoy This Massage?
items.a: Not at all. A muscle recovery massage can also be enjoyed as a relaxing body wellness experience.
